$description: Structured copy of the Android answers on DREAMT-4719 (2026-11-19) that scripts read. Source data: do not edit. Wording and full answer: 2026-11-19-DREAMT-4719-android.md in this folder.
source: Rajal Patel, DREAMT-4719 comments 276725 and 276735, 2026-11-19; android-tribpub (commit not stated; our export is 1cfb069a6)

statusbar_tsar.note: Barely visible white icons on the off-white bar (MISSING-ASSETS 5.5: production is not white with dark icons)

top_bar.title: Roboto Medium 16sp, all caps
top_bar.title_exceptions: Restaurants and the corekit settings screen use the plain AppCompat title: Roboto Medium 20 (answer says 20dp)

buttons.system: No app-wide button style; plain Buttons get Material library defaults
buttons.main_screens: MaterialComponents theme: Roboto Medium 14sp, ALL CAPS, letterSpacing 0.0893
buttons.m3_screens: Settings / web view / paywall (Material3 theme): Roboto Medium 14sp, sentence case, line height 20sp
buttons.pressed: None designed. Material ripple on Material buttons, ?selectableItemBackground ripple on some views; the monthly subscription option has no pressed state. Legacy selectors: What's New close pressed #FF6859; update-app dialog button #076C9C → #6E8D9B pressed.

alerts_enable.label: Roboto Medium 14sp, all caps, white
alerts_enable.alerts_tab: The Alerts-tab "Enable Alerts" is a system AlertDialog button

whats_new.label: Open Sans Bold 14sp (18sp landscape, 25sp tablet), all caps, white

settings_background.why: The Settings theme paints the window and every view white in the ~70 markets that keep #333333; ct, dp, hc, mc, nydn, tod, vp set Settings_Background itself to white

skip.material_ok: Material Symbols' 10 s icons work as they are

fonts_45.NYDN: OpenSansCondensed-Bold.ttff does not load; falls back to Roboto Regular (time/blurb line in notification and stream lists). Fix: rename to .ttf
fonts_45.MC: OpenSans-Semibold.ttf would not load, but Article_Byline_Regular / Article_Dateline_Regular are not referenced by any style; MC bylines and datelines use OpenSans-Bold.ttf

widget.size: minWidth 300dp, minHeight 170dp, target 2×1 cells, not resizable, refreshes every 30 min
widget.layout: 16dp rounded card, 16dp padding. Date 12sp top-right. Logo 145 × 25dp. 2dp divider1. Lead row: 66dp-wide thumbnail (7dp corners), bold 15sp headline (max 3 lines). 2px divider2 at 12dp. Second headline bold 16sp (max 2 lines).
